title: airport/seaport dreams turned megalophobic nightmare
content: okay i am having recurring dreams about getting on huge boats and planes, specifically ships at a large seaport in new york. i have to take a complicated subway to get there, and when i di, the hallways are winding and complicated but at this point i know my way around. i then get on a huge boat or plane and go on a journey where i see terrifyingly huge sculptures, monuments, and animals, and then arrive in a foreign area with enormous buildings and scenery. nothing in what i've described here justifies how much these dreams scare me 😭
